note: US dollars per million tokens. Empty on purpose: prices change and must come from the provider's price list. Add entries as { "provider": "openai", "model_prefix": "gpt-example", "input_per_mtok": 0.00, "output_per_mtok": 0.00 }, set `version` (for example a date) and `as_of`, and commit. Until a model has an entry its cost is recorded as `unknown`.
